'''Gervruche''' was the Minister of all [[Imperial Special Corrections Facilities]] prior to the commencement of the initial negotiations for the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] project. Gervruche was killed before the negotiations could be completed, allowing for Lady [[Chawkroft]] to conspire with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to bring the project through negotiations. Gervruche was survived by his widow, the Lady [[Gervruche (widow)|Gervruche]].
